name: Granisetron Hydrochloride

fda.text: Serotonin Syndrome The development of serotonin syndrome has been reported with 5-HT3 receptor antagonists alone but particularly with concomitant use of serotonergic drugs (e.g., selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs), serotonin and norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors (SNRIs), monoamine oxidase inhibitors,…

summary: Official warnings note that taking this drug alone or especially alongside certain other medicines can lead to a condition known as serotonin syndrome [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests done on people, estimated low scores for liver risk and heart risk [M]. The specific liver score was forty-six and the heart score was forty-one [M].
